title: Playboy July 1989 Shelly Jamison TV Newscaster Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Covers bright; spine intact. A patch of surface scuffing/peeling on the front cover at the lower right edge (see photo), plus light edge wear. No tears. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
description:
Playboy magazine, July 1989 issue, original $4.00 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover: TV newscaster Shelly Jamison (KTSP-TV). Also: Golf in All Its Glory; Playboy Interview with Barry Diller; a Vietnam vet gets straight talk from Afghan vets.

Back cover: Toyota Trucks ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
